cohort: The cohort consisted of 177 patients diagnosed with placenta accreta who underwent trans abdominal hysterectomy.
finding: The study found no significant association between maternal age, BMI, history of D&C, placental position, surgical incision type, gestational age, number of previous C/S, or type of anesthesia and the occurrence of placenta accreta or its associated complications (blood loss, urologic problems).
mod_finding: The number of previous Cesarean Sections (C/S) was not related to the amount of blood loss.
cross-section timing: Data were collected between March 2011 and March 2017.
gest_age: The average gestational age was 34.6 ± 3.16 weeks.
